title: actual published main comparator (origin/main at start)
section: ## Scope
wording: - **Residence.** Article 9 of [Ley 35/2006](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2006-20764): resident if **either** (a) more than 183 days in Spain in the calendar year (sporadic absences count unless tax residence elsewhere is proved), **or** (b) the main base or centre of activities or economic interests is in Spain. There is also a rebuttable presumption where the spouse (not legally separated) and minor children live in Spain. A resident is taxed on worldwide income.

wording:
**Home supplies (suministros).**
- Only where part of the taxpayer's **main home** (vivienda habitual) is used for the activity. A second home is not covered by this rule.
- Covers water, gas, electricity, telephone and internet of that home.
- Deductible share: **30%** of the proportion "entre los metros cuadrados de la vivienda destinados a la actividad respecto a su superficie total", "salvo que se pruebe un porcentaje superior o inferior". The 30% is a default, not a cap, and it can be lower too.
- Separate business premises: supplies of those premises are deductible in full under the general rule.
destination: Current LF328/333 main-home30%×businessareafractionorprovedalternative; separatepremises follow actualbusinessuse/generalcostrules. CurrentIRPFpartialasset/indivisibility rule prevents chosenunsupportedprivate/businesspercentages.

section: ## Who this applies to
wording: Use the ordinary resident regime for individuals in the fifteen autonomous communities whose scales appear below. [Ley 35/2006 (LIRPF), arts. 8–9](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2006-20764#a9) taxes resident individuals on worldwide income. Residence follows **more than 183 days** in Spain in the calendar year, counting the statutory sporadic absences, **or** the Spanish main centre/base of activities or economic interests. There is a rebuttable spouse/minor-child family presumption. Exactly 183 days does not meet the day limb but does not settle the other limbs. A Spanish address, nationality or bank account alone does not establish the answer.

title: frozen GitHub-public PR branch body
section: ## Who this applies to
wording: Determine the autonomous community under [art. 72](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2006-20764#a72): most days, then the defined main-interest test if days cannot decide, then last declared residence. Apply its anti-avoidance and residence-change rules. Do not select whichever community gives the lowest tax. Establish family unit and individual/joint filing under arts. 82–84 before calculating allowances or reductions.

section: ## Who this applies to
wording: Navarra and the three Basque foral territories use [their territorial IRPF Guide](es-foral-income-tax.md); they are outside these fifteen common-territory tables. Ceuta/Melilla have separate territorial calculations, including the 2026 Ceuta changes. Non-residents follow IRNR; special incoming-worker elections follow art. 93. An arrival or departure does not create an assumed ordinary split-year return: settle domestic and treaty residence and any exit charge first.

wording: Assume a 40-year-old individual Madrid resident with no relatives giving minima, no other income, no joint return and no other credits. Hypothetical certified gross wages are **EUR 18,000**, deductible employee contributions **EUR 1,150**, and withholding **EUR 600**. title: frozen GitHub-public PR branch body
section: ## Two worked examples that recompute / ### Example 1: an employee's reduction and 2026 low-pay credit
wording: Art. 20's reference income is **EUR 16,850**, before the separate EUR 2,000 allowance. Its reduction is `7,302 − 1.75 × (16,850 − 14,852) = 3,805.50`. The taxable general base is **EUR 11,044.50**. State and Madrid tax use their respective minima of **EUR 5,550** and **EUR 5,956.65**. Rounding each half's computed liability to cents gives **EUR 521.98** and **EUR 432.47**. The 2026 DA 61 credit is `590.89 − 0.2 × (18,000 − 17,094) = 409.69`, below the attributable-tax cap. Tax after this credit is **EUR 544.76**, leaving a **EUR 55.24 refund** against EUR 600 withholding.
